scripts.build: npm run build -w @screenshare/shared && npm run build -w @screenshare/server && npm run build -w @screenshare/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @screenshare/shared && npm run lint -w @screenshare/shared && npm run lint -w @screenshare/server && npm run lint -w @screenshare/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @screenshare/shared" "npm run dev -w @screenshare/server" "npm run dev -w @screenshare/web"
